subject: prd/docgate
statement: When invoked with a merge base, docgate shall fail a diff that touches a governed contract class — a PRD ledger entry (`NNN-<slug>.md`), an authored technical design (`docs/tech-design/*.md`, excluding the generated `index.*`), or the incident registry — if the same diff also touches implementation/capability paths or a second governed class; the generated projections (`effective.*`, `index.*`) and the live rollups (`docs/techspec.md`, `docs/prd.md`) are exempt, riding with their source or with the code respectively.
rationale: one concern per PR becomes code for the governed classes; the contract is reviewed on its own before code builds against it, so FR-16 precedence holds in fact and not only at lint time
fit_criterion: temp-repo fixtures: an amendment + a design → red (two classes); an amendment + code → red; a design + code → red; incident + code → red; a lone amendment with its regenerated `effective.*` → green; a lone design with its regenerated `index.*` → green; a pure code or rollup change → green
